known_issues: Sign-in flow is glitching: user cannot reliably sign in; typing a name in the input box deletes itself and the field blinks.

existing_features.title: Fix the login/sign-in form glitch where the name input clears itself and blinks while typing by ensuring the TanStack Router instance is not recreated on every render in `frontend/src/App.tsx` (keep the router stable across renders while still receiving updated auth context).

projectName: Fix sign-in name input glitch by preventing TanStack Router recreation
